items.title: NSE seeking valuation of as much as ₹5.26 trillion in planned IPO
items.description: At a $55 bn valuation, NSE's sale of 6% stake on offer could raise about ₹315 billion, surpassing the ₹278.7 billion raised by Hyundai Motor's Indian unit in 2024, the country's largest IPO to date
